description: This Kotlin source file defines the DebugHandler class for Android application debugging tasks. It provides methods to perform diagnostics on Ed25519 key operations and retrieve device logs, specifically for debug builds.

classes.name: DebugHandler
classes.description: Handles debugging commands, including performing cryptographic diagnostics and retrieving system logs, mainly for development use in debug builds.

methods.name: handleEd25519
methods.description: Performs diagnostics related to Ed25519 key operations, such as signing, verification, and provider checks, returning diagnostic information as JSON.

methods.name: handleLogs
methods.description: Retrieves device logs and system information, filtering spam patterns, and includes camera debug logs if available, returning logs as JSON.
